mode_order_policy: Deterministic rotation among F-S-A, S-A-F and A-F-S using (repeat+map_index-1) mod 3

stage1.gate: Every triplet must be source/resource/speed/infrastructure valid; Full and Adaptive must each complete 5/5 with zero contact

stage2.start_condition: stage1 gate passes exactly as frozen

failure_policy.full_or_adaptive_failure: Stop for diagnosis after preserving the complete triplet
failure_policy.sector_failure_or_contact: Retain as comparison outcome and continue if all validity checks pass
failure_policy.infrastructure_or_measurement_failure: Stop for diagnosis; do not silently replace

measurements: Adaptive Full open/close and committed ACK counts
profiling: CPU profiling enabled for every mode and run
interpretation_limit: Observed n=10 rates and computational measurements; not a formal population-level safety guarantee
